content:
"God’s will is clear—your choices are sinful. Repent or face His wrath. I’ll pray you see the error of your ways, but don’t drag me into your rebellion. True love means calling out your disobedience, even if it hurts."

*(Note: This is an example of toxic behavior, not biblical love. True Christian love is patient, kind, and respects boundaries—1 Corinthians 13:4-7.)*
